entries.name: Frostbitten Quest Chains
entries.chainDesignNote: Every side-story chain is structured as a compact VN arc with phase labels, map movement, event pressure, character beats, combat hooks, and one small mini-game beat. The GM may skip systems that do not fit the current session, but the content is ready for all tabs.

chains.title: Frostcap Fever
chains.type: side story: food shortage -> grove route -> puzzle forage -> light combat -> tavern consequence
chains.flowSummary: A cozy tavern shortage becomes the first clean Frostwood field run, then folds back into food, warmth, and the Pocket Haven garden later.
chains.summary: Tessa turns a missing mushroom basket into a low-risk field run that teaches Frostwood movement, gathering, and light combat without derailing Arc 1.

phasePlan.title: Empty Stew Pot
phasePlan.summary: VN/tavern opening, Tessa asks for help.

phasePlan.title: Bent Pine Route
phasePlan.summary: Move across the Frostwood grid toward the grove.

phasePlan.title: Basket Puzzle
phasePlan.summary: Mini-game sorting beat for safe caps.

phasePlan.title: Stew Returns
phasePlan.summary: Tavern wrap and recipe/Pocket Haven seed.

steps.label: Empty Stew Pot
steps.text: At the Frosted Mug, the stew pot is so empty the cook has started apologizing to it. Tessa asks Bin to collect Frostcaps before the dinner rush turns political.

vn.prompt: Write a short tavern VN scene where Tessa, the cook, Bin, and Bowy turn a food shortage into a friendly first quest. Keep the jokes warm and practical.
beats: Tessa frames the job as safe
Bin distrusts the word safe
Bowy volunteers too quickly
The cook offers a terrible bonus: one bowl of experimental stew

character.beat: Tessa shows she trusts Bin with a small public job after his return.

event.prompt: The tavern reacts to the missing stew with comic urgency.

steps.label: Bent Pine Route
steps.text: Use the Frostwood Grid Patrol route. The party should move from the sled start through Bent Pine toward Frostcap Grove while learning grid movement.

map.objective: Reach Frostcap Grove and mark at least one safe return lane.

progressTriggers.log: Quest pulse: the Frostcap route is found.

steps.label: Sort The Safe Caps
steps.text: The grove has edible caps, glow caps, and one cap that squeaks like it has opinions. Sort the basket before the sprites notice.

minigame.objective: Push the safe Frostcaps into the basket spaces and leave the blue squeaking cap alone.
minigame.contextText: Frostcap Grove's basket sort is an active side-story step. Clearing it marks the safe-cap route and gives the room bonus.

conversation.speaker: Bowy
conversation.text: Safe caps in the basket, squeaking cap out. I would like my soup to have fewer opinions.

minigame.bonusText: Clear bonus: Frostcap route progress plus the mini-game room buff and JP payout.

winOps.text: Frostcap basket sorted without poisoning the stew.

failOps.text: The basket sorting goes badly; the grove starts paying attention.

steps.label: Frost Sprite Nest
steps.text: Sprites defend the warm snow circle. Let gathering actions count as progress, or use the Frost Sprite Grove battle card.

combat.objective: Gather enough Frostcaps or clear the sprite nest.

progressTriggers.log: Quest pulse: the grove fight is handled.

steps.label: Return The Stew
steps.text: The Frosted Mug serves warm stew again. The suspicious blue cap is saved as a future recipe or Pocket Haven seed.

event.prompt: A warm tavern wrap scene where the town relaxes and the cook insists the squeaking mushroom was artisanal.

character.beat: The cook becomes a recurring food-loop contact.

followUpHooks: One blue cap does not rot. It hums near Pocket Haven soil. Promote only as yellow-risk content.

chains.title: The Ledger of the Ghost
chains.type: side story: paperwork comedy -> signature route -> document puzzle -> sparring/social duel -> guild status restored
chains.flowSummary: A public comedy chain that turns Bin's return into guild bureaucracy, gives the town a reason to react, and restores his quest-board status.
chains.summary: Corvin needs proof that Bin is alive enough to sign guild forms, and the town treats that as group entertainment.

phasePlan.title: Living Person Waiver
phasePlan.summary: VN opening at the guild counter.

phasePlan.title: Signature Route
phasePlan.summary: Move through guild, gate, tavern, and forge witnesses.

steps.label: Living Person Waiver
steps.text: Corvin presents a form confirming Bin is not a corpse, ghost, legal rumor, or taxable haunting.

vn.prompt: Write a fast guild-counter VN comedy scene where Corvin explains why Bin must prove he is alive. Keep Corvin dry, Lysa too cheerful, and Bin offended by the tax section.
beats: Corvin produces too many forms
Lysa loudly congratulates Bin on legal breathing
Bin tries to sign once and finds three more initials required

event.prompt: The guild lobby notices the words legally alive and stops pretending not to listen.

steps.label: Four Witnesses
steps.text: Move through Frostbitten witnesses: gate office, Frosted Mug, forge, and guild desk. Each signature gives a different joke and a small hub read.

map.objective: Collect Lysa, Tessa, Hilda, and Corvin signatures without letting Dain turn it into a speech.

character.beat: Lysa signs immediately, then adds a smiley face Corvin refuses to accept.

steps.label: Sort The Forms
steps.text: The forms must be sorted into Alive, Missing, Probably Fine, and Please Stop Asking piles.

minigame.objective: Push each form stack into the correct filing tray before Corvin starts using legal vocabulary as a weapon.
minigame.contextText: The guild form sort is filed as Lysa's side-story paperwork step. A clear result updates the witness chain and pays the training bonus.

conversation.speaker: Corvin
conversation.text: Alive, missing, probably fine, and please stop asking. These are official categories because I wrote them down.

conversation.speaker: Bin
conversation.text: That is how law works when everyone is tired.

minigame.bonusText: Clear bonus: Lysa's witness chain advances plus the mini-game room buff and JP payout.

winOps.text: Guild paperwork sorted well enough to count as alive.

failOps.text: Guild paperwork sorting creates another rumor.

steps.label: Dain's Objection
steps.text: Dain claims Bin is abusing a dramatic return loophole. Resolve as a public roast, social check, or nonlethal spar.

combat.objective: Win the crowd without turning Dain into a real enemy.

progressTriggers.log: Quest pulse: Bin turns the paperwork duel into a public laugh.

steps.label: Stamp Restored
steps.text: The guild stamp accepts Bin's name. Corvin files the page like he personally defeated a dungeon.

event.prompt: Wrap with the guild stamp finally accepting Bin's name, the crowd pretending it was not invested, and Dain demanding a rematch later.

character.beat: Corvin becomes warmer by acting exactly as annoyed as before.

chains.title: Warm Lights, Cold Hands
chains.type: side story: supply problem -> sled route -> latch puzzle -> ambush -> hub repair
chains.flowSummary: A practical firemoss shortage chain that teaches map travel, resource stakes, and town warmth consequences.
chains.summary: The missing firemoss shipment needs a supply-trail run before Frostbitten's burners dim.

phasePlan.title: Broken Sled
phasePlan.summary: Node-map movement to the sled trail.

phasePlan.title: Warm Lights
phasePlan.summary: Return firemoss and repair hub warmth.

steps.label: Cold Lamps
steps.text: Tessa posts the firemoss shortage while the guild lamps sputter. The joke lands because the room is actually getting colder.

vn.prompt: Write a Frostbitten guild VN scene where a practical supply shortage shifts the room from comedy to responsibility without becoming grim.
beats: Tessa names the missing sled
Kael pretends he is not nervous
Garr quietly marks a safer route
Bin takes the job before the lamps embarrass everyone

event.prompt: The town notices the firemoss lamps dimming.

steps.label: Broken Sled Route
steps.text: Use the Frostwood Short Run. Start at the edge, inspect the broken sled, then follow cache marks toward the ridge.

map.objective: Reach Broken Sled and Hunter Cache before the cold clock worsens.

progressTriggers.log: Quest pulse: the missing sled route is found.

steps.label: Frozen Cache Latch
steps.text: The firemoss cache is intact, but the latch is frozen in a way that suggests a craftsman had a personal grudge against hands.

minigame.objective: Move ice blocks away from the latch before the cache cracks.
minigame.contextText: The frozen cache latch is part of the winter-lane side story. Clearing it secures the firemoss cache and applies the room bonus.

conversation.speaker: Peri
conversation.text: The latch is frozen in three different directions. That feels personal.

conversation.speaker: Bin
conversation.text: Then I will answer personally and push the ice.

minigame.bonusText: Clear bonus: cache progress plus the mini-game room buff and JP payout.

failOps.text: The firemoss cache opens late and the route gets colder.

steps.label: Snowblind Ridge
steps.text: Fake toll collectors or hungry wolves hit the return route. Pick the battle that fits current danger.

combat.objective: Get the firemoss sled past the ridge with supplies intact.

progressTriggers.log: Quest pulse: Snowblind Ridge is clear enough for the sled.

steps.label: Warm Lights
steps.text: The burners come back. The town does not cheer loudly; it just stops hunching its shoulders.

event.prompt: A quiet Frostbitten wrap scene where warmth returns to the guild and Kael realizes supply runs count as courage.

character.beat: Kael learns that brave work can look boring until the lamps come back.

chains.title: Ironhand Errand
chains.type: side story: forge repair -> route hunt -> bellows puzzle -> field test -> recipe unlock
chains.flowSummary: Hilda turns gear repair into a practical prep chain that supports future boss readiness without forcing main-plot reveals.
chains.summary: Hilda needs frost-resistant binding material before the forge can repair winter gear reliably.

steps.label: Bad Iron
steps.text: Hilda explains the repair queue and the bad iron shipment while hammering a nail so flat it becomes a legal document.

vn.prompt: Write a forge VN scene where Hilda explains bad winter gear with blunt affection and no patience for heroic posing.
beats: Hilda names the bad shipment
Bowy asks one useful question
Bin offers to help and regrets using forge vocabulary

character.beat: Hilda accepts Bin as useful because he listens to materials instead of speeches.

steps.label: Pelt Marks
steps.text: Follow wolf tracks toward usable winter pelts. The goal is not trophies; it is material that will hold under frost.

map.objective: Reach Wolf Tracks, then choose Wolf Den or Bear Hollow based on danger.

progressTriggers.log: Quest pulse: usable pelt marks found.

steps.label: Bellows Timing
steps.text: Back at the forge, the wrap compound needs heat, cold, and timing. Hilda refuses to call it delicate. It is delicate.

minigame.objective: Move coal and frost blocks into rhythm positions before the binding paste cracks.
minigame.contextText: Hilda's forge timing puzzle is a town-phase side-story beat. Clearing it locks in the pelt-wrap preparation and grants the training bonus.

conversation.speaker: Hilda
conversation.text: Hot here, cold there, no heroic improvising in the middle.

conversation.speaker: Bin
conversation.text: I will be extremely brave about following instructions.

minigame.bonusText: Clear bonus: forge preparation progress plus the mini-game room buff and JP payout.

failOps.text: The first binding paste batch tears and costs extra pelt.

steps.label: Field Test
steps.text: Use the repaired grip wraps in a wolf or bear fight. The test is complete if the party survives with the gear intact.

combat.objective: Win one practical field fight with the repaired gear.

progressTriggers.log: Quest pulse: Hilda's winter gear survives a field test.

steps.label: Recipe Card
steps.text: Hilda writes a basic cloak recipe in handwriting that looks like it fought the paper.

event.prompt: A forge wrap scene where Hilda gives the party a recipe card, a discount, and one compliment disguised as criticism.

chains.title: Thunder Needs a Voice
chains.type: side story: Bowy character beat -> creek trail -> target puzzle -> wolf den -> quiet choice
chains.flowSummary: A Bowy-focused side route that builds confidence and Thunder identity while keeping Garr clues soft.
chains.summary: Bowy follows a trail of old crossbow bolts toward a wolf den. Keep Garr clues soft unless GM promotes them.

steps.label: Broken Bolt
steps.text: Bowy finds an old bolt that warms in his hand. He jokes first because the silence would be too honest.

vn.prompt: Write a quiet Bowy/Bin VN scene around an old crossbow bolt. Keep Garr implications emotional but indirect.
beats: Bowy notices the bolt before Bin does
Bin lets Bowy take point
Garr is mentioned only as old route knowledge
Thunder is treated as a name Bowy has to grow into

character.beat: Bowy asks to lead one route instead of being assigned one.

steps.gmNote: Do not force Garr's hidden truth. This is a soft character beat.

steps.label: Frozen Creek Trail
steps.text: Use the Frozen Creek route and let Bowy choose path calls. He can be right without becoming perfect.

map.objective: Cross the creek, read the old hunter marker, and choose whether to press toward the den.

event.prompt: A hunter marker hints that someone older knew this route, but it does not name Garr or reveal the past.

steps.label: Thunder Finds A Line
steps.text: Bowy maps a clean shooting lane through snow and branches before the den fight.

minigame.objective: Thread Bowy's route through blockers without trapping Bin in the wolf lane.
minigame.contextText: Bowy's target-board route is a side-story setup before the den fight. Clearing it opens a clean line and applies the room bonus.

conversation.speaker: Bowy
conversation.text: If the line bends here, the shot stays clean and Bin stays unbitten.

conversation.speaker: Bin
conversation.text: I am strongly in favor of that second half.

minigame.bonusText: Clear bonus: thunder-line setup plus the mini-game room buff and JP payout.

winOps.text: Bowy finds a clean line for Thunder.

failOps.text: Bowy's first line is messy, but he adjusts before panic can take it.

steps.label: Wolf Den
steps.text: Use a wolf battle set or resolve manually. Bowy's action should matter in the encounter description.

combat.objective: Clear the den and let Bowy make one decisive call.

progressTriggers.log: Quest pulse: Bowy's wolf den trail is resolved.

steps.label: Quiet Return
steps.text: Bowy decides Thunder is not about being loud. It is about being heard at the right time.

event.prompt: A quiet return scene where Bowy receives confidence without a grand speech.

ops.note: Bowy has started defining Thunder for himself.

chains.gmNote: Do not force Garr's hidden truth. This is a soft character beat.

chains.title: Three Silver and a Funeral Discount
chains.type: side story: rival comedy -> receipt route -> ledger puzzle -> public arbitration -> recurring friendly rivals
chains.flowSummary: A low-stakes Brinna Twins comedy chain that can recur between heavier chapters and keeps Frostbitten socially alive.
chains.summary: The Brinna Twins claim Bin's old three-silver debt accrued emotional interest while he was missing.

steps.label: Debt Claim
steps.text: Ella and Nessa Brinna claim Bin owes three silver plus emotional interest, funeral-adjacent handling fees, and one apology with garnish.

vn.prompt: Write a quick Frosted Mug VN comedy scene where the Brinna Twins itemize an absurd three-silver debt and Bin negotiates badly.
beats: The twins produce an invoice
Bin cannot remember the original debt
The Mug takes sides based on snack access
Lysa offers arbitration because she wants to watch

character.beat: The twins become recurring friendly rivals instead of one-off gag NPCs.

steps.label: Receipt Hunt
steps.text: Move through town to search the Mug cellar, guild counter, and gate lost-and-found for the original receipt.

map.objective: Visit three town nodes and pick which witness gets to define the original debt.

event.prompt: Each witness remembers the debt differently and with suspicious confidence.

steps.label: Ledger Math
steps.text: Sort coin slips, apology slips, and fake emotional-interest notes before Corvin declares the math cursed.

minigame.objective: Push real receipts into one pile and fake emotional-interest claims into another.
minigame.contextText: The ledger puzzle is the town-phase proof step for the three-silver side story. Clearing it sorts real debt from theatrical debt and pays the room bonus.

conversation.speaker: Corvin
conversation.text: Real receipts left, fake emotional-interest claims right. Do not let the fake claims learn confidence.

conversation.speaker: Bin
conversation.text: Too late. I can still file them.

minigame.bonusText: Clear bonus: ledger proof progress plus the mini-game room buff and JP payout.

winOps.text: The three-silver ledger is sorted with only minor dignity loss.

failOps.text: The ledger math creates a stronger rumor than the debt deserved.

steps.label: Public Arbitration
steps.text: Let Lysa or Corvin arbitrate the absurd interest. Resolve as social combat, roasting, or sincere payment.

event.prompt: Public arbitration where the crowd reacts like this is a championship match.

combat.objective: Optional nonlethal spar if Dain tries to sponsor the twins' argument.

progressTriggers.log: Quest pulse: Bin survives arbitration by making himself the punchline.

steps.label: Friendly Rivals
steps.text: The debt becomes a recurring friendly rivalry: three silver, payable in coin, errands, snacks, or future embarrassment.

event.prompt: Wrap the chain by turning the Brinna debt into a running joke that can reappear between serious chapters.

ops.note: Use between heavy scenes as a pressure valve.
